notes: Posted 1 June 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

The byline 'Jesus "Savior" Christ' is a prank name, so the deck is credited as plain text to the DeckTech handle 'Savior' with no player page. The same poster's other deck is DeckTech 16328 (TIGIH Beatdown Post Tatooine, Light).

Starting cards as posted under Starting (8): Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place (posted 'Bring him BeforeMe/TYFP'), Death Star II: Throne Room, Insignificant Rebellion, Your Destiny, Prepared Defenses, Imperial Arrest Order, Mobilization Points, First Strike; these count toward the 60. Several Effects start and none is named as the starting Effect, so none is set.
Posted 'Mara Jade,Emperors Hand (down her pants)' dested Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand (the parenthetical is a joke, not a card).
Posted 'Rebel Barrier x2' in this Dark deck dested Imperial Barrier, the Dark counterpart (Rebel Barrier is a Light card).

Posted 'Myn Kanough' dested Myn Kyneugh; 'IG-88 With Gun' IG-88 With Riot Gun; '4-Lom with Gun' 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'Janus' Janus Greejatus; 'Twilek' Twi'lek Advisor; 'Control Combo' the Dark Control & Set For Stun; 'Sniper Dark Striker' Sniper & •Dark Strike; 'Vaders Saber' Vader's Lightsaber (Premiere); 'Mara's Saber' Mara Jade's Lightsaber; 'Rendilli' Rendili.

Posted 'Tattoine Docking Bay 94', 'Endor Docking Bay' and 'Cloud City Docking Bay' dested the Dark pages (Tatooine: Docking Bay 94 (Dark), Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay) (Dark), Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay)); 'Death Star 2 Docking Bay' Death Star II: Docking Bay; 'Weapon Levitation' the Dark Cloud City interrupt.
